### Added
- **`qwen3-5-4b-hf`: Qwen3.5 4B from the Hugging Face Hub on one 24 GB GPU** (giantswarm/model-manager#98, #106; epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). This is the `qwen3-5-4b` recipe (arguments, resources, fit 9 + 6 GiB) with `storageUri: hf://Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B` in place of the signed model image. Every other preset that fits a 24 GB card ships as an `oci://` model image, which `pull_model` refuses by design, so the Hub download Job, the model cache claim and a predictor starting from the cache could not run on the smallest GPU pool. An installation serves `qwen3-5-4b`. `verify-gpu-pool` leaves a preset added to or retired from the line-up out of its comparison with the golden ref.
